scope: Finite original-neighbor FD laws in the literal ten-triangle, three-bit-per-vertex encoding, whose syndrome support lies in an affine binary subspace of dimension at most two.

literal_definitions.word: One binary component x_v^t at each incident vertex/factor; X_v is its three-component tuple; sigma_t is the XOR of the three t-components.
literal_definitions.original_fd: For each v, H(X_v | X_{N(v)}) = 0, using the literal full neighborhood including edge 3-4.
literal_definitions.graph_source_warning: Agreement with the named publisher figure is not independently checked: the PDF is not a whitelisted metadata body. The literal graph is the conditional theorem input until separately checked under authorization.

fiber_semantics.plane: Write the containing affine plane as s0 + A*a + B*b for linearly independent a,b in F2^10; S=(A,B) is a possibly nonuniform, dependent or degenerate random pair. A point or line may first be extended to a plane.
fiber_semantics.selected_factors: J is the set of coordinates nonconstant on the chosen ambient plane, not necessarily the set nonconstant on the actual law. Each selected t has sigma_t=c_t+l_color(t)(S); l in {A,B,A+B}. Other factor tuples are fixed as conditioning variables.
fiber_semantics.original_neighbor_fd_in_fiber: On each positive-probability fixed-factor fiber, supply all fixed component values as constants to the original graph decoders, obtaining H(Y_v | Y_N(v))=0. No independence is assumed.
fiber_semantics.state_determinism: The chosen direction map has rank two, hence the selected parities jointly determine S; H(S|Y_V)=0 even if the law occupies fewer than four points.
fiber_semantics.local_set: L_J(v) is the union of the other vertices of selected triangles incident to v, not an assumed graph neighborhood FD.
fiber_semantics.full_local_decoder: H(Y_v | Y_L_J(v), S)=0 by solving each incident XOR component; the empty selected tuple is constant.
fiber_semantics.single_functional_decoder: H(Y_v | Y_L_J(v), l_c)=0 is authorized by this lemma only when the nonempty set of colors on selected incident factors is exactly {c}; every per-factor affine offset is known. A different or missing guard requires a separate proof.
fiber_semantics.visibility: Each incident selected parity gives its functional from Y_N(v): the graph FD first recovers Y_v, then the other triangle bits are present at neighbors. If the incident restrictions have rank two, equivalently contain two different nonzero colors, H(S|Y_N(v))=0. One incident color alone does not generally give full S.
fiber_semantics.tensorization: Process fixed-parity factors first, each conditional fixed-parity triple obeying 3H(Z_t|past)<=2 sum_{v in t}H(x_v^t|past). Apply the selected-block bound in every positive fixed-factor fiber, sum by chain rule, and enlarge each right-hand entropy by replacing all-past conditioning with that vertex's own past. No factor independence or uniformity is used.

proper_nine_variable.encoding: entropy bitmask on the specified ordered nine vertices

full_state.encoding: entropy bitmask on Y1,...,Y10,S; bit 10 is full S, not an independent binary variable

functional_branch.encoding: id=5*m+b for 0<=m<=1023; m is the ten-vertex subset mask
forbidden_interpretations: full S is one binary bit
A and B are independent random variables
the five branches are separate unrelated laws

authorized_row_schemas.formula: H(Z_i | Z_K)>=0 and I(Z_i;Z_j | Z_K)>=0, with valid disjoint indices and an ordinary joint variable set
authorized_row_schemas.checker_duty: Reconstruct every entropy coordinate algebraically from the variables and conditioning set; branch-translated rows must additionally satisfy the auxiliary semantics.

authorized_row_schemas.guard: Literal original neighborhood and actual fixed-factor fiber.
The selected factor restrictions span the dual of the two-dimensional ambient plane.
L_J(v) and parities reconstructed from the actual selected triangles, not from a smaller graph FD.
The nonempty set of selected incident colors is exactly {c}; preserve affine offsets.
Selected factor t has color c and Y_T_t contains all three actual t-components.
A selected factor of color c is incident to v; use the original graph FD and both other t-components.
Actual incident parity projection has rank two on the specified direction plane.
l_c is a deterministic function of the same S, and the expanded coordinates are exact.
c and d are distinct nonzero F2^2 linear forms, so their pair is bijective with S; this is I(l_c;l_d|Y_K).
All selected triangle parities are fixed given S, and S is determined by Y_V. Derive 3H(Y_V|S)<=2 sum_v H(Y_v|S) by conditional fixed-parity triangle tensorization.

row_policy: A row not matching one of these schemas, or a separately explicitly derived admissible Shannon/FD consequence with a checked derivation, is UNKNOWN and must be rejected rather than inferred from a name. Do not import functional-fiber Delta gates, two-syndrome theorems, numerical caps, non-Shannon inequalities, or author receipts. Verify each actual row, not just each row family.

exact_identity_contract.arithmetic: Parse rational numerators and positive nonzero denominators exactly; do not use floating-point tolerances. Reject duplicate/ambiguous coordinates, invalid masks, unknown fields or row/action types, malformed colors and undeclared action images.
exact_identity_contract.reconstruction: For each row rebuild its unweighted sparse entropy vector from its semantic descriptor; independently apply each declared legal action and compare every resulting image vector with the literal vector. Include H(empty)=0 and account for all other coordinates.
exact_identity_contract.averaging: Recompute sum_rows multiplier/action_count * sum_actions image_vector exactly. A transformed row is legal only if its own guard holds on the actual target law; averaging never licenses an invalid image.
exact_identity_contract.proper_targets: D2 and D3 must equal respectively 13 and 72 times (2 sum_{v != k} H(Y_v)-3H(Y_{-k})), on all 511 coordinates. A ge row requires a nonnegative multiplier; an le row requires a nonpositive multiplier; zero FD equalities have unrestricted signs.
exact_identity_contract.delta_targets: An n11 target is Delta<=0 on all 2047 coordinates. A functional target is 3Delta=3H(Y_V)-2 sum_v H(Y_v)<=0 on all 5119 coordinates. A ge row requires a nonpositive multiplier, an le row including G_S requires a nonnegative multiplier, and a proven zero equality has unrestricted sign.
exact_identity_contract.coverage_and_binding: Verify every certificate's exact source binding, class/color/selected-factor identity, row count, target, action list and all coordinates; inventory cardinality or matching hashes alone is not evidence that any identity or binding is valid.

transport_contract.graph_permutation: Rebuild each vertex bijection and check every adjacency in both directions; for proper-subgraph FD inequalities graph automorphisms are sufficient.
transport_contract.factor_permutation: For any encoded-law transport, derive the factor permutation from g(T_t)=T_{p(t)} for every ordered-list triangle; a graph automorphism alone is insufficient.
transport_contract.stabilizers: For a within-certificate average, recompute the induced selected-factor set and every required visibility/local-color guard for each image. Preservation of J and of a required visible set is sufficient where claimed; otherwise every image must be separately proved valid on the target law.
transport_contract.plane_and_color: Transport all three nonzero direction vectors as literal ten-bit factor-coordinate permutations. For residual colorings, recompute the induced GL(2,2) change of full S and its three nonzero linear forms; there are six possible bijections of those forms. Affine basis offsets may complement functionals but do not change their entropies.
transport_contract.direction: Check source-to-client and client-to-source maps with explicit inverse/roundtrip equations and verify source and client actual plane, factor set, colors and row premises; do not rely on action names or class numbers.
transport_contract.finite_control_scope: Eight listed graph actions and four listed factor actions were checked as closed subgroups on the literal graph in the tiny control. Exhaustion of the entire automorphism group was not checked and is not needed when exact orbit coverage is otherwise proved.

universal_coverage_contract.universe: U is the exact set of sorted triples {u,v,u xor v} of distinct nonzero ten-bit vectors; equivalently canonical rank-two RREF subspaces. Independently generate the set, not a count alone. Claimed size 174251.
case_precedence: noncover: selected triangles miss a graph vertex
full-visibility: remaining planes whose W contains an admitted full-model visibility generator
mixed-visibility: remaining planes with an independently verified applicable J/visibility certificate and transport
residual: all remaining planes with an independently bound functional coloring identity and transport
universal_coverage_contract.set_equality: Require each roster key to be a valid rank-two plane, each claimed predicate and each action/ID binding to hold, no duplicate keys, pairwise disjoint categories, and exact equality of their union to U. Compare actual sets and predicates, not only sizes.
universal_coverage_contract.four_factor: Independently show covering sets need at least four factors; for |J|=4 reconstruct the exact color, visibility and residual-orbit subcases. For each proposed universal color enumerate every selected-component difference with syndrome in the direction plane and every graph-FD-necessary active mask; reject a nonzero mask contained in one color class. Verify exact set equality to the four-factor universe.
universal_coverage_contract.proper_subgraph: Check the deletion-1 proper coloring, the two exact D2/D3 identities, the literal graph transports, and that the induced nine-variable FDs hold after conditioning on each deleted vertex. Do not infer the two exact identities from their claimed hashes.
universal_coverage_contract.residual: Bind each zero-based class ID to its actual canonical coloring, all factor/GL actions, the source certificate's literal colors and exact identity, and every residual plane-to-class map. Compare the orbit union with the independently generated residual set.
